title: Signature 43 · USSBBW · Celadon Kintsugi · Dark Gallery
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, short sculpted natural curls.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body kintsugi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Pale celadon ceramic glaze with fine crackle and blazing raised gold repair seams. The gold seams cover the whole body, a thick gold seam running beneath every single belly roll so each heavy roll is outlined in gold, more gold seams tracing the deep side rolls and the folds of the thighs, darker glaze settling into each deep crease. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a relaxed contrapposto with her feet planted apart, her weight on one leg so that huge hip juts outward, arms held away from the body, never covering the belly.

Footwear: Extremely high platform stiletto mules in translucent iridescent pearl. Nails: extra long stiletto, gold mirror tips.

Background & Lighting: A dark museum gallery at night with charcoal walls and no objects, a single warm spotlight from above carving deep shadows between each belly roll, making every gold seam glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss ceramic finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
